ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 使用 Jsoup 解析 HTML 并定位正文内容节点
let documentObj = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
let contentContainer = documentObj.getElementById("BookText");

// 获取解密乱序内容所需的种子、校验值、属性名及偏移量
let seed = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-r"));
let totalCountKey = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-t"));
let attributeName = contentContainer.attr("data-a"); 
let offsetKey = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-k"));

// 计算应显示的有效段落总数并初始化存储容器
let actualParagraphCount = totalCountKey ^ (seed % 256);
let allParagraphs = contentContainer.select("p");
let validParagraphList = [];

// 遍历段落并还原真实的显示索引
for (let i = 0; i < allParagraphs.size(); i++) {
    let pElement = allParagraphs.get(i);
    let fingerprint = pElement.attr(attributeName);

    // 仅解密带有指纹属性的有效段落
    if (fingerprint) {
        let targetFingerprint = parseInt(fingerprint, 16);
        let recoveredIndex = -1;

        // 通过迭代匹配还原哈希算法混淆前的原始索引
        for (let idx = 0; idx < 1000; idx++) {
            let hashValue = (idx * 31 + offsetKey) >>> 0;
            hashValue = (hashValue ^ ((seed >> 3) & 0xFFFF)) >>> 0;
            
            // 模拟 32 位乘法溢出逻辑计算指纹
            let multiplier = 0x9e3779b1;
            let lowBits = (hashValue & 0xffff) * multiplier;
            let highBits = (hashValue >>> 16) * multiplier + (lowBits >>> 16);
            hashValue = (((highBits << 16) | (lowBits & 0xffff)) >>> 0) & 0xFFFFFF;

            // 匹配指纹成功后记录索引并中止循环
            if (hashValue === targetFingerprint) {
                recoveredIndex = idx;
                break;
            }
        }

        // 将索引合法的段落源码存入待排序数组
        if (recoveredIndex >= 0 && recoveredIndex < actualParagraphCount) {
            validParagraphList.push({
                htmlContent: pElement.outerHtml(),
                orderIndex: recoveredIndex
            });
        }
    }
}

// 清空结果变量并按照还原的索引顺序合并段落
result = "";
validParagraphList.sort((first, second) => first.orderIndex - second.orderIndex);
for (let j = 0; j < validParagraphList.length; j++) {
    result += validParagraphList[j].htmlContent + "\n";
}

result;
</js>

result = result.replace(/.*点击广告.*aifun.*\n?(-+\n?)?/i, "");

// 移除包含报废提示的行，并可选地移除其随后由横杠组成的分割线行
result = result.replace(/.*书源全部报废.*下载APP.*\n?(-+\n?)?/i, "");

// 移除包含署名或网址的行，并清理行前后的换行符
result = result.replace(/\n?.*幻梦轻小说.*\n?|\n?.*huanmengacg\.com.*\n?/g, "");
</js>
